page.overview:
Who is Moqueca?

Moqueca is the king of the in the South Blue and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

Moqueca is a short, rotund middle-aged man with a thin mustache. He wears a frilly shirt, a bead necklace, robes and a colorful, feathered hat resembling a palm tree.

Moqueca is a cheerful, jovial man who enjoys samba.

Moqueca is the king of a nation affiliated with the World Government and one of the few allowed to attend the Levely, which grants him some authority over matters concerning the world.
